description_en: Restarts a specified ApsaraDB for ClickHouse cluster
description_zh: 调用RestartInstance接口重启指定云数据库ClickHouse集群
kebab_example: aliyun clickhouse restart-instance --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-cluster-id cc-bp108z124a8o70000 --api-version 2019-11-11 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RestartInstance

parameters.help_en: The region ID. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170875.html operation to query available region IDs
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170875.html接口查询地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The cluster ID. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170879.html operation to query information about all clusters in the destination region, including cluster IDs
parameters.help_zh: 集群ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170879.html接口查询目标地域下所有的集群信息，包括集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values:

30 (default)

50

100
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数，取值：
30（默认值）
50
100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The scheduled restart time. The time must be in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format and in UTC.

If this parameter is empty or specifies a time earlier than the current time, the cluster is restarted immediately
parameters.help_zh:
预约重启的时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）。
当该参数为空或填写早于当前时间时，集群将立即进行重启
parameters.name: restart_time
